Thrift Stores in Omaha

By
Andrea McCormick
-
October 12, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:58
Instaread

Do you love the thrill of the hunt or finding a great deal? Shopping at thrift stores and consignment shops in Omaha is a fun way to discover unique treasures while saving money! From affordable clothing and shoes to home decor, furniture, and vintage finds, Omaha has plenty of thrift stores to explore. Whether you’re searching for secondhand bargains or one-of-a-kind pieces, grab your shopping bag and get ready to discover some of the best thrift stores in Omaha!

Thrift Stores in Omaha

Assistance League Omaha
8502 West Center Road Omaha
Shop for  antiques and collectibles, men’s and women’s apparel, accessories and shoes, books, housewares, linens, home decor, seasonal items, and jewelry. Visit the store or shop online! 

Forever Yesterday
9006 Maple St. Omaha
Find vintage, antique, thrift, and liquidation items. Recently reopened after flooding. 

New Life Thrift Store 
7007 S 36th St. Bellevue
Shop a huge selection of kids clothes and shoes, furniture, housewares, jewelry, and more. 

St. Vincent de Paul
With multiple locations in Omaha, SSVP has quality clothing, furniture, home décor, and more at deeply discounted prices.

Thrift World
Shop at multiple locations in Omaha and Council Bluffs, as well as online. 

// RELATED CONTENT: Where to Donate in Omaha //

1404 Collective 
1404 S. 13th St. Omaha
Find a mix of vintage and secondhand goods here. New items are added regularly!

Style Encore
305 North 78th St Omaha
Shop for gently used clothes, shoes, and accessories for men and women. 

Albany & Avers
5011 Underwood Ave., Omaha
A vintage shop located in the heart of Omaha. Find a curated collection of vintage, preowned, and secondhand women’s apparel Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, or by appointment.

Send us an email if we missed anything, and we’ll add it.
